payload.blocks: phase 7 and the plan close of 261124-0004, any further release run, and the CHANGELOG land of 261125-1558 that waits on it
payload.headline: Release run failed npm test; who runs the unconfined suite to name the failures for heads-operate phase 7?

parts.cause: Both the supervisor and the lead are confined: the lead's own run shows 45 failures that are all git-addon-not-shipped or read-only-filesystem refusals, so it cannot judge. The supervisor's route to the unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session is the mailbox, and fgos mailbox send to lead:SUPERVISOR (and to its handle claude-xonu@fg-server2) fails host-failed from inside the confinement; no peer is reachable through SendMessage.

options.cost: About 15 minutes of that session; no lines changed
options.does: You tell the unconfined lead:SUPERVISOR session (forgent-1f) to run npm test then cargo test --workspace on main 91ffc370f or later and raise the failing names on event b6d58fc0bb31c826
options.gain: Unblocks phase 7 with real, unconfined results; no code change
options.label: Owner relays to lead:SUPERVISOR

options.does: You run npm test and cargo test --workspace in a plain terminal on main and paste the failing names on the event
options.harm: Takes your terminal for about 15 minutes
options.label: Run them yourself

options.does: Leave phase 7 parked until the mailbox send failure from confined heads is fixed
options.harm: heads-operate and the land-door CHANGELOG land stay blocked for an unknown time; no release
options.label: Wait

parts.recommendation: Relay to lead:SUPERVISOR: it is the unconfined session meant for exactly this, and it is live.

scope.allows: One unconfined npm test and cargo test --workspace run on main and posting the failing test names on event b6d58fc0bb31c826
scope.forbids: Fixing any failing test, landing code, or another release run before the failures are judged

parts.what: The supervisor's release run (ticket c-2778617-1795616029739, main 91ffc370f, 21:13-21:24) ended checks-failed: npm test exit 1. The ticket keeps no list of failing tests. The heads-operate lead needs the failing test names from an unconfined npm test and cargo test --workspace to judge whether any failure is its own.
